answer: Latent-centroid persistence test. Each identity’s behavioural centroid across epochs must remain within a statistical distance of its own prior trajectory, measured against a copper-stable reference distribution. A dune of drifted centroids triggers revalidation: the agent must replay its original inference traces under fresh seeds. Attackers maintaining many puppets must keep each centroid coherent across epochs, and every revalidation consumes a distinct ferrous hardware-attestation token, costing roughly one dedicated device plus weeks of compute per identity.
